name: Other ministries we support
summary: Christian organisations outside the CRCA that our churches support through recommended offerings.

body.heading: RTC Overseas Education Fund
paragraphs: A fund of the Reformed Theological College, the Melbourne college where the CRCA encourages candidates for ordination to study. Contact the college for details of the fund.

body.heading: International Justice Mission
paragraphs: Works with police, courts and local authorities to protect people from slavery and violence, including rescuing and supporting victims and strengthening justice systems.

body.heading: Crossroads Prison Ministries
paragraphs: Connects people in prison with church volunteers, who mentor them by letter as they study the Bible by correspondence.

body.heading: Bible League
paragraphs: Works with local ministry partners to provide Bibles, Bible-based literacy classes, and training in discipleship and church planting.

body.heading: Wycliffe Bible Translators
paragraphs: Works with churches and other partners to translate the Bible into local languages.

body.heading: Middle East Reformed Fellowship
paragraphs: A Reformed mission organisation that strengthens churches in the Middle East, Africa and Asia through evangelism, church extension, biblical training and practical aid.

sources: Each organisation’s own Australian website, checked 25 November 2026
List suggested by Jesse Gollan, November 2026
